m-jacksonville|2025-07-14|c5b3c0cd|598d1.body: Neighborhoods, Community Services, Public Health and Safety Committee
m-jacksonville|2025-07-14|c5b3c0cd|598d1.title:
AMENDMENT
Attach Revised Economic Development Agreement to:
   1. Include Specific Default that failure to create 10 New Jobs by 12/31/29 shall result in 
       termination of REV grant and return of all prior distributions
   2. Correct Scrivener’s


• Authorizes an Economic Development Agreement with Project Moana (“Company”)
• Estimated total private capital investment of $90,000,000 related to expansion of existing 
  distribution facility
• Authorizes a 5-year 60% REV Grant not to exceed $2,500,000
   - The REV Grant will be proportionately reduced if a minimum capital investment of 
     $90,000,000 is not met by 12/31/29 and terminated if a minimum capital investment of 
     $50,000,000 is not met by 12/31/28
   - The REV Grant will be proportionately reduced if the Company fails to maintain a minimum 
     of 100 New Jobs and 480 Retained Jobs throughout the term of the REV Grant, and 
     terminated if the Company fails to maintain a minimum of 80 New Jobs, at a minimum average 
     salary of $46,800, and 480 Retained Jobs throughout the term of the REV Grant
• Establishes a deadline of 12/31/28 for completion of construction of the improvements
• Establishes New Jobs creation of 12/31/28 for the first 50 and 12/31/29 for second 50 (total 100)
• OED has calculated the ROI as 3.68 over a 10-year period
